outcome: Static named world-reference state and Initialization authoring foundation are deployed
owner_impact: Initialization can now define validated named static reference points and assign per-agent reference sensors with finite or unlimited range. The simulator stores one canonical initial reference state and reconstructs current reference state on reset, with periodic relative-position geometry already centralized for the next step. This ticket deliberately does not expose or advertise reference observations to Controller or Metrics yet, so existing Experiments and currently available authoring capabilities remain unchanged.

next.text: Epic #501 continues with #504 — add selective per-agent Controller reference sensing, expose the same reference state read-only to Metrics, then advertise and mark the capability implemented. #504 has not started yet.

technical_evidence: Browser and MCP Initializer compilers remain byte-identical and emit vlab.initializer-state/0.4 with a vlab.world-references/0.1 payload.

Initialization validates stable identifier names, finite/in-arena reference positions, agent indices, duplicate definitions/assignments, undefined reference links, and finite positive or unlimited sensor ranges.
Rust owns separate initial and current WorldReferenceState values; reset reconstructs current state from the initial state, leaving a clean future dynamics seam without implementing dynamics.

Named-reference relative geometry reuses the simulator minimum-image helper; no neighbour-search/world-discovery path, Controller observation, Metrics surface, optional executable artifact, or paper-specific behavior is introduced.
The implemented-capability registry remains unchanged, so observation.named_reference_relative_position stays candidate_unavailable until #504.

Production highlighting smoke validates Ace session tokenizer output rather than viewport-dependent rendered token spans, preserving the syntax-highlighting assertion for hidden/inactive editor surfaces.
